text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*, *sob*... Where did you go? 
Golshi-chan's King Sperm Whale...! He must 
be lost and crying right now...!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Sperm whale...? Ah, could you be referring 
to that whale-shaped teapot?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I was wondering who could have possibly 
left this in the committee room... I see. 
So it belonged to Golshi-san.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Fret not, We have conscripted that fellow. 
Presently, he fulfills his duties in Our 
and dear Sister's quarters.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
You've managed to find quite a good item 
for once. I shall praise you—the tea 
brewed with that goes surprisingly well 
with seafood chazuke.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Don't just confiscate and consume it on 
your own! That's Golshi-chan's precious 
sperm whale meat, ya hear?! Give... it... 
baaaack!!!!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Now then, it was on our shared territory. 
Naturally, it ought to belong to 
me—wouldn't you agree, Dear Sister?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...Excuse me, Golshi-san. It seems 
Orfevre has taken quite a liking to that 
teapot... Would you perhaps be willing to 
let us keep it as is?"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
No way in hell! That guy's my partner, 
we've turned seven bowls of tea into seas 
together!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
In that case! How about making the 
Expedition Support Committee's teacup into 
a whole new ocean for Mackau-san and 
Golshi-san?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Golshi-san gets to enjoy a new sea, and we 
get to befriend Mr. Sperm Whale —don't you 
think that sounds wonderful?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh, interesting waves. Don't blame me 
if not just the teacup, but the whole room 
turns into the Golshi Sea, ya hear?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... This is where we accept the 
challenge —right, Orfe?
